# Monkeytype — gauntlet critic

Blind A/B against https://monkeytype.com (Miodec). Played the original in Chromium and this port from `apps/monkeytype/` (local server, gifos.db mocked). One browser. Desktop 1280 and phone 390 / 360. Two pages joined through the mocked room for the race. Distinct from `apps/typing` (lessons + programmer passages, MIT, keyboard icon).

**winner:** COMP

**single biggest remaining gap:** The store art is not the app. `screenshot.png` / `cover.jpg` is a pixel-font ALL-CAPS pangram (`THE QUICK BROWN FOX…`, fake `87` / `96%`) generated by `icon.mjs` `screenshotPng()`. The window I typed in is serika-dark, mixed-case common words, `ui-monospace`, yellow caret after `on` / `hous`. A shopper who knows monkeytype.com would not recognise this product on the card, and a shopper who has already seen `apps/typing`'s cover (same dark pixel type, same caret-in-a-sentence trick) would not tell them apart. Hero on `/store.html#app=monkeytype` and the phone listing both show this fake. Crop is full-bleed (`coverCrop.top: 0`), no shell toolbar — the crop is fine; the picture is wrong.

**would a stranger who knows the original use this copy:** "I would use the GifOS one on a plane, and to race a friend from one link — the original is a tab, a cookie banner, an account if you want a record, and it still has no live race. I will not install from that cover. That is not the test I just typed, and it looks like the other typing app in this store. Retake the cover from the real window mid-test (lowercase words, yellow caret, live `30`) and then the offline + file + race sentence is enough; until then I stay on monkeytype.com."

**HARD WALL:** none. Zero requests off the app origin. No webfont, no CDN, no `localStorage`, no `fetch`. `COPYING.txt` (GNU GPL-3.0) rides inside the GIF (`GifOS.gif.decode` lists it, 35149 bytes, starts with the GPL preamble). Listing `license` is `GPL-3.0`, author is Miodec, `basedOn.blessed` is false, donate URL is theirs. `prefs` is private; `match` / `players` are read-write; Invite is OS chrome (no `#invite`). `minBuild` 947. English + 1k + 82 quotes is a product gap versus the original's hundreds of languages and 6488 quotes, not a lie — the listing does not claim them.

## Face (always judged)

- **Icon (64px):** Caret types `THE LAZY`, then `87 WPM` lands. 12 frames, 100 ms. The loop demonstrates the test; it does not wiggle. At real Home Screen size the WPM frame reads; the typing frames are cramped but the yellow bar is visible. Original has no animated icon. Distinct from `apps/typing`'s keyboard. Small structural win.
- **Store art:** See the gap. Card (320-wide) still reads as "a typing test" and nothing more. Beside this catalog's best covers (2048's board-plus-race pitch) it looks like a sibling of Typing, not of monkeytype.com.
- **Listing copy (read on `/store.html#app=monkeytype`, desktop and 390):** Tagline *The typing test, offline — personal bests live in the file, one invite is a live race.* Description leads with no account / plane / GIF-is-the-save / invite-is-a-race, then the test, then unofficial Miodec. That is the right shape. Claims checked against the build are true: words and quotes, yellow caret, time 15/30/60/120, words 10/25/50/100, punct/numbers, Tab, Escape, live bars, same seed, GPL unofficial. Unofficial-port pill and License GPL-3.0 render. Better store copy than the original's one-liner. Not enough to win the A/B while the hero disagrees with the window.

## The test (caret, WPM/acc, words/quotes)

The running test is the original's. Serika-dark, `monkeytype` logo with yellow `type`, 3-line word flow, config pill (`@ #` / time words quote / 15 30 60 120 / english), Tab restart, Escape command line. Typed `on` — letters go `--text`, caret is a 3 px yellow bar at the end of the word, config fades, live `30` appears. Words-10 finished at 100% acc with `51/0/0/0` chars, raw, consistency, `new pb`, one history row (bot WPM is not a product number). Quote mode showed a Lord of the Rings line with source; short / medium / long / all buckets all returned real quotes. Punct+numbers produced `Before world 7, leave; 16 must?` and quoted words. Dracula swapped the sheet to `rgb(40, 42, 54)`. Command line is the original's `>` box.

It is still a sketch of the original, not a better one: system mono instead of Roboto Mono, no zen / custom / thicc, no result graph, live WPM waits for 5 keys, twelve themes not four hundred. "As good as" is losing. The test is why you open monkeytype.com; this copy has the test, not the payoff screenshot.

## Bests in the GIF

`onFinish` writes `pbs` + last 40 results to `gifos.db('prefs')` (private) and paints `pb N` / `new pb` / history. Listing claim is true of the code. This session's reload did not keep the mock store (in-memory), so persistence was not independently proven here — the write path was exercised (PB flag set, history length 1).

## Live race invite

Worked across two pages in one Chromium. Host sees "Press Invite in the bar above…"; guest sees "Waiting for the host to start" and no Start button; both names land. Countdown `3`/`2`/`GO`. Same eight words on both clients (`set possible also by number should head they`). Live bars: Host (you) 36, Guest 0, yellow track. No server. That is the platform win the original never shipped (Tribe never reached monkeytype.com).

The lobby is unfinished: `show('race')` leaves `#testView` visible, so the practice words, caret, and "click to focus" sit on top of "Race a friend". During countdown the veil still says click. Hide the practice test for the lobby.

## Phone (390 and 360)

No horizontal overflow. Config wraps. Three lines of words. Tap focuses, caret tracks `hous|e`, live `30` appears, 16 px hidden input (no iOS zoom). Race buttons are thumb-sized. Original is a desktop site with a cookie modal; this is the more honest small screen.

Gaps: veil copy is still "click to focus"; boot auto-focus hides the veil, so a real phone that refuses keyboard without a gesture has a blinking caret and no "tap to type"; "race a friend" wraps under the hint at 360.

## GPL notice

Packed: `COPYING.txt` inside the GIF. Store: License GPL-3.0, Unofficial port of Monkeytype, author Miodec, bugs to GifOS. `help.md` names the unofficial port. In-app chrome has no footer, no About, no GPL string in `document.body`. Original puts contact / github / terms in a footer. Distribution notice is satisfied; interactive notice is listing + help, not the test chrome. Not a wall.

## Distinct from `apps/typing`

Different job: this is monkeytype's word-flow test (time/words/quote, WPM/acc/raw/consistency, themes, command line, GPL). Typing is lessons and programmer passages (MIT). Icons differ. Taglines differ. Covers do not — both are dark pixel-font mid-sentence carets. That is the collision the gap names.

The run is not done. Retake `screenshot.png` from the real window at mid-test (the `on| take with what…` frame), so the card is this app and not Typing. Until a stranger looks at that card and says "that's Monkeytype," bar two does not matter.
